freezer_roundtrip.procedure: Bind the complete post-link $e000 window to the current candidate identity, enter and leave the Freezer once, then compare all 8192 bytes and execute post_freezer_resume.
freezer_roundtrip.pass: $e000 is byte-identical to the current post-link pin and the resumed form returns 3
freezer_roundtrip.identity_rule: The row expires on every product-identity change and must never inherit green from an older candidate.
freezer_roundtrip.first_red: Any byte drift, failed Freezer return, mapping drift or wrong resumed result stops the presmoke.

diagnostic_limits.boot_to_repl_basis: Link-29 receipt-less hardware observation: approximately 30 seconds
diagnostic_limits.definition_first_call_target: C2.3 owner-pin candidate: 15 frames, with one-frame edge quantization shown separately

policy.first_red: Stop on a malformed result, unstable boot-counter read, wrong Lisp result or diagnostic-limit overrun.
policy.claim_limit: Receipt-less fail-fast hardware pre-smoke only. Limits classify this candidate; they are not promotion, acceptance or a release claim.
